method: For each tracked project whose page is on the developer's or the project's own website, the domain registration date from the registry's RDAP service (found through the IANA RDAP bootstrap) and the earliest TLS certificate for the domain or any subdomain in Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh). Dates are published to the month and the domain itself is not published in this file. Pages on listing portals, agents or news sites are marked third-party: their domain age says nothing about the developer. A domain can be re-registered or bought second-hand, so an old domain is not proof of an old company; a young one next to a long claimed history is a question to ask. Certificate Transparency logging became mandatory in 2018, so certificates before then may be missing.
